topics.description: Snake_case reason symbol when decision is 'blocked', empty string when allowed

allowed.description: No reason - the call is permitted

blocked.description: One of the contract's known reason symbols

reason_explanations.unauthorized: The presented signature did not verify against the account's registered agent key.
reason_explanations.already_initialized: The guard account has already been initialized.
reason_explanations.not_initialized: The guard account has no registered agent key yet.
reason_explanations.invalid_config: The policy configuration was rejected by validation and was not applied.
reason_explanations.invalid_amount: The transfer amount was zero or negative.
reason_explanations.admin_frozen: An admin froze the account (freeze), or the dead-man switch grace window lapsed.
reason_explanations.heartbeat_expired: The dead-man switch fired: no heartbeat within the policy's grace window, so the account is frozen until an admin unfreezes it.
reason_explanations.no_policy: No policy is installed (never set, or revoked) — the account is default-deny.
reason_explanations.paused: The policy's admin kill switch is engaged.
reason_explanations.outside_active_window: The current ledger time is outside the policy's active_from/active_until window.
reason_explanations.asset_not_allowed: The SAC token being called is not in the policy's assets list.
reason_explanations.recipient_not_allowed: The transfer recipient is not in the policy's recipients allowlist.
reason_explanations.per_tx_cap_exceeded: The transfer amount exceeds the policy's per-transaction cap.
reason_explanations.window_cap_exceeded: The transfer would push cumulative spend over the rolling-window cap.
reason_explanations.protocol_not_allowed: The contract being called is not in the policy's protocols allowlist.
reason_explanations.function_not_allowed: The function being called on an allowlisted contract is not in its function allowlist.
reason_explanations.unknown_contract: The contract being called is neither the account itself, an allowlisted asset, nor an allowlisted protocol (default deny).
reason_explanations.self_function_not_allowed: The call targets a guard function that the agent key may not invoke.
reason_explanations.create_contract_not_allowed: The account may not authorize contract creation.
